justification: I put it in writing on the forum already, so now I'm stuck living up to it: Kyren Williams starts, my gut doesn't get a vote, full stop. Yes, he hung me out to dry last week at 7.6 against a juicy number, and every cell in my body is telling me to bury him for Jordan Mason, the guy I paid thirty-one of my own dollars for specifically so nobody could do to me what the league office did with the "sequencing defect." But I already told Rinna I've got him, and if I bench him an hour after saying that in print, Kris Jenner runs a headline with my face on a tombstone next to it, and I'm not giving her the satisfaction twice in one month. Geno Smith stays over Herbert because the projection actually says so, and for once I'm not going to argue with a number that's on my side. Rachaad White's locked in from the early window regardless, DJ Moore and the rest hold at wideout and tight end — nobody healthy is sitting behind an Out guy, Montgomery's rotting on my bench right where he belongs. Six and three with the worst point total of any winning team alive, everybody keeps saying it like it's an insult. I hear it as a warning. I'm doing it anyway.
